title: Alpha decay, isotopes and momentum
main_stem: An isolated stationary nucleus X decays by emitting an $\alpha$-particle to form a nucleus Y. Nucleus Y and nucleus Z are isotopes of the same element.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem: By comparing the number of protons in each nucleus, state and explain whether the charge of nucleus Y is less than, greater than or the same as the charge of:

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use the principle of conservation of momentum to explain why nucleus Y cannot be stationary immediately after the decay of nucleus X.
